summary: --role-skeleton copies a custom skeleton into a new role, rendering .j2 files outside templates with role_name and skipping .git. You can set role_skeleton and role_skeleton_ignore regexes in ansible.cfg.
questions: How do I use my own template for new roles?
How do I make ansible-galaxy ignore certain files in my role skeleton?
Can I set a default role skeleton in ansible.cfg?
Which variables are available in role skeleton .j2 files?

answer_card.title: Custom role skeleton
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-galaxy role init --role-skeleton=/path/to/skeleton role_name
```
It copies everything from the skeleton, renders `.j2` files outside `templates/` (only `role_name` is useful), and skips `.git` and `.git_keep`.

Or set it in `ansible.cfg`:
```ini
[galaxy]
role_skeleton = /path/to/skeleton
role_skeleton_ignore = ^.git$,^.*/.git_keep$
```
Ignore patterns are regexes matched against directory names and relative paths: root files look like `./README.md`, nested ones like `plugins/README.md`.
